text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "This is due to a cost-effective low-technology heating and ventilation system incorporated in prefabricated parapet elements and connector fans in the doors.", "gist": "The system uses low-tech heating and ventilation in prefabricated parts and door fans to keep costs low."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "University of St. Gallen", "gist": "The new tenant of the building"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The new occupant, the University of St. Gallen, is very pleased with the climate in the rooms and the energy costs.", "gist": "The University of St. Gallen is satisfied with the room climate and energy expenses."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "\"Kegel’s Rule\" could catch on in the refurbishment of further office buildings as well as in dwelling house construction and new builds.", "gist": "Kegel’s Rule may become popular in future building projects."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Umwelt Arena Schweiz and René Schmid Architekten AG", "gist": "The organizations involved in the project"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "With heart and mind towards energy self-sufficiency with interconnection – the development at Männedorf is a model ecological and economic project.", "gist": "The Männedorf development is presented as a model for eco-friendly and economical energy self-sufficiency."}]}
